reactNative.assets: Metro require(...) numbers or URI strings
reactNative.initialize: await warmUpEngine(); rebuild the app after native engine changes

workflow: Initialize once per scene, after warmUpEngine.
Store gameplay in a shared TypeScript factory returning world, camera, update and input functions.
Use React state for UI changes rather than every object transform.
Define round start, stop, reset and result handling in the game layer.
On pause, stop updates and input; on reset, clear timers, actors, input and round flags.
Cache mesh/model/font/sound preparation outside the frame loop.
Cancel late asynchronous setup and dispose the world on unmount.

distinctions.entity: A handle for one object in one World
distinctions.model: A reusable mesh; spawn entities from it
distinctions.pause: Stop updates and input while retaining the current world
distinctions.reset: Application function that prepares a fresh round
distinctions.time: dt and animation/timer durations are in seconds
distinctions.coordinates: World Y is up; ground movement uses X/Z. Screen input is local view points or CSS pixels.

verification: The game surface has a real size.
Start, score, win, lose, stop, replay and cleanup work.
Input and clock do not advance while paused.
Web assets load from the built host over HTTP(S).
Only claim native runtime verification after exercising a native build.
